en: Colorized vintage view of a small railway station with a main station building on the left and several freight or passenger cars on tracks to the right. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink, and there are telegraph poles, lamps, and a fenced area near the building. The scene is labeled in German at the top with the location and indicates that this is a train station (Bahnhof).
